title: Tage Thompson has hat trick, 5 points in Sabres' 7-6 win over Ducks
text: Tage Thompson has hat trick, 5 points in Sabres' 7-6 win over Ducks - Tage Thompson had three goals and two assists, Zach Benson added a goal and two assists, and the Buffalo Sabres scored six consecutive goals during a 7-6 victory over the struggling Anaheim Ducks on Thursday night. tied him with Alexander Mogilny and Danny Gare for the third-most in Sabres history. One night before his 29th birthday, Thompson scored twice in 15 seconds in the second period, skating around Anaheim's inert defense for a breakaway third goal that sent a dozen hats flying onto the Honda Center ice.made 28 saves for the Sabres, who roared back from an early two-goal deficit and then hung on to improve to 2-0-1 on their four-game trip.ended his nine-game drought with two goals for the Ducks, who led 3-1 in the first period before getting blitzed 6-0 by Buffalo over the next 35 minutes.had three assists in the Ducks' seventh loss in eight games. Husso stopped 23 shots for Anaheim, which is without injured defensemen After Granlund and Gauthier got power-play goals 57 seconds apart, McQueen put the Ducks up 3-1 with a rebound goal from the slot. The 6-foot-5 center made Anaheim's roster out of training camp at 20 years old, but hadn't yet scored an NHL point.
